description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Building Materials and Testing topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: building-materials

facts.claim: Bricks are mainly clay, fired (burnt) for strength

source.quote: Properly, the term brick denotes a unit primarily composed of clay

facts.claim: Mortar binds masonry units; made of sand, binder and water

source.quote: Bricklayers typically make mortars using a mixture of sand, a binder, and water

facts.claim: Binder is usually Portland cement or lime

source.quote: The most common binder since the early 20th century is Portland cement, but the ancient binder lime

facts.claim: Timber comes from hardwoods and softwoods
Rolled in standard shapes (I-sections, channels, angles)

source.quote: Structural steel is steel used for making construction materials in a variety of shapes

facts.claim: Bitumen is a viscous product of petroleum

source.quote: Bitumen (UK: BIH-chuum-in, US: bih-TEW-min, by-) is an immensely viscous constituent of petroleum

facts.claim: Gives ultimate tensile strength and elongation

source.quote: ultimate tensile strength, breaking strength, maximum elongation and reduction in area

facts.claim: Compressive strength: resistance to loads that shorten the specimen

source.quote: compressive strength (or compression strength) is the capacity of a material or structure to withstand loads tending to reduce size
Indentation hardness measures the resistance of a sample to material deformation due to a constant compression load from a sharp object

facts.claim: Fatigue: cracks grow under cyclic loading

source.quote: fatigue is the initiation and propagation of cracks in a material due to cyclic loading

facts.claim: Aggregates are coarse to fine particles (sand, gravel, crushed stone)

source.quote: is a broad category of coarse to medium-grained particulate material used in construction

facts.claim: The slump test checks workability of fresh concrete

source.quote: It is performed to check the workability of freshly made concrete

facts.claim: Asphalt (bituminous) mixes are aggregate plus bitumen laid and compacted

source.quote: It consists of mineral aggregate bound together with bitumen
